name: Nina Chatu’s brokerage
goals: Find safe channels for aid, cargo and correspondence.
Hear a disputed repayment without putting the creditor’s word above the record.
bio: Nina Chatu’s introductions carry letters and business across households. The bookkeeper Kannan wants a witnessed account of his own debt, not another patron’s promise.
notes: fact: Nina Chatu helped the Portuguese prisoners and later held office; Birch also puts him and Cogequirmani in an eastern trading venture (Pires II, pp. 258, 281; Birch III, pp. 125–129, 162–163)
gameplay: Chatu is not the pre-conquest Keling shahbandar; Kannan and the debt case are invented (people-factions.md §2; port-labour.md §§3–4)
